name: Vulpix

atk.x: Your opponent switches his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

fl: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Torchic

atk.x: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

fl: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Fennekin
fl: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Magikarp

atk.x: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

fl: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Totodile

atk.x: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

fl: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Pikachu

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

fl: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Scraggy
fl: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

name: Jigglypuff

atk.x: Discard a Darkness Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

fl: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

name: Togepi
fl: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

name: Dedenne

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

fl: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Meowth

atk.x: If this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached to it, this attack does 20 more damage.

fl: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Eevee

atk.x: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

fl: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.
